description.zh: 业务隔离ID，用于隔离同一个阿里云账号下不同业务应用之间的数据。请与调用[AddFaceUser](~~288338~~)接口添加用户时设置的**IsolationId**保持一致。
description.en: The business isolation ID, which is used to isolate data between different business applications under the same Alibaba Cloud account. Set this parameter to the same value as the **IsolationId** specified when you called the [AddFaceUser](~~288338~~) operation to add a user.

description.zh:
用户名。支持中文、英文字母大小写、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-），长度不超过64个字符。

支持模糊匹配，若不填，则为全量匹配。
description.en:
The username. The username can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and Chinese characters, and can be up to 64 characters in length.

Fuzzy match is supported. If you leave this parameter empty, all records are matched.

description.zh: 指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。最小取值为1。
description.en: The page number to return. Minimum value: 1.

description.zh: 返回结果中，每页显示的记录数量。最大取值50，最小取值1。
description.en: The number of records per page. Maximum value: 50. Minimum value: 1.

description.zh:
用户参数，请自定义。

支持匹配搜索，但不支持模糊匹配。
description.en:
The custom user parameter.

Exact match is supported, but fuzzy match is not supported.

title.zh: 通过人脸名称查找人脸数据
title.en: Query face data by face name

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明

- 单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为100。

    > RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Usage notes

- The maximum number of queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account when you invoke this operation is 100.

    > Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
